outcome: Prevalence of CHTN combined with GDM
cohort: 378,366 pregnant women from a large cohort study, with 1,418 having CHTN (1,027 CHTN alone, 391 CHTN with GDM)
finding: Pregnant women with CHTN combined with GDM had a significantly higher risk of cesarean section, placental adhesion, preeclampsia, and macrosomia compared to those with CHTN alone.
